<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that converts a nitro group to an amine. Use nitrobenzene as the target molecule and specify that the forward reaction breaks a nitro group and forms an amine.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
